initial_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the first time step. Naive local datetime with no zone or offset.

TimeAxis.description: One continuous timeline. An emulation model, a power flow, and a security analysis use it. The axis name is time.

initial_timestamp.description: Start timestamp of the first solve. Naive local datetime with no zone or offset.

interval.description: Time between the starts of two solves.

ExecutionAxis.description: The start timestamp of each solve: initial_timestamp + k*interval, for k < count. Each decision model has one, also for a single solve, where count is 1. The axis name is execution.

resolution.description: Time step between two horizon steps.

horizon_count.description: Number of horizon steps in one solve.

HorizonAxis.description: The step offset inside one solve. It has horizon_count steps of the given resolution. Each decision model has one. The axis name is horizon.

has_ids.description: True when the column stores component ids.

columns.description: Component types of the columns. Each column holds the components of one type.

subset.description: Optional suffix of the axis name. The axis name appends it after two underscores to the component types. It has no slash, because the axis name is one HDF5 path segment.

ComponentAxis.description: One entry for each component. The axis name is the component_type values of the columns, joined with two underscores. A subset adds two underscores and the subset value.

name.description: Axis name. It is lower snake case and is not time, execution, or horizon.

LabelAxis.description: An axis whose entries are not components and not time. It has only fixed string labels. IOM uses it for an extra column dimension of some store arrays. The axis name is the name field.
